title: WHAT IS NEW IS A PAUSE MENU BUTTON
why: His answer 37: the What is New card moves to a button on the pause menu. It used to pop up by itself on the Undercroft floor once for each time you loaded the game, over the screen you had come to look at. It no longer does. The pause menu has a WHAT IS NEW button beside FEEDBACK; it opens a window with the newest eight notes, in the same words the card used, with CLOSE and ESC to shut it. The card stamp and the list are unchanged, so the build refresh that keeps the list current works as before.
now: The What is New card is now a button on the pause menu, and no longer pops up by itself.
